name: Weber Lois
kurzbeschreibung: Snack station at 1,110 m above Neustift in the Stubaital, with a sun terrace and panoramic views over the entire valley.
beschreibung:
The Jausenstation zum Weber Lois is located at around 1,110 metres above sea level, above Neustift in the Stubaital, Tyrol. From Neustift, the alpine hut can be reached on foot in about 30 minutes via Lehner, Obergasse or Stackler, and it is also located on the Eins-Einser-Trail near the Elfer.

As a classic Tyrolean snack station, Weber Lois welcomes guests with a traditional Tyrolean Jause and hearty home-style dishes. The wonderful sun terrace with its wide views over the entire Stubaital and the surrounding mountains is particularly popular.

The hut is open all year round, with Tuesday being a day of rest. Anyone exploring the Neustift area will find a cosy spot here to take a break and enjoy the view.
